purpose: Starting points for HistFactory-style likelihoods: a pyhf counting workspace, a shape workspace, post-fit nuisance diagnostics for pyhf, and a CMS Combine datacard template
environment: E1 (docs/capability-matrix.md) plus pyhf 0.7.6 (numpy backend, scipy optimizer); CMS Combine 11.1.0 from conda-forge, checked with its ROOT 6.40.04 and ROOT 6.36.14 builds, run through $HEP_COMBINE_WRAPPER; AsymptoticLimits needs --strictBounds with ROOT 6.40 (VALIDATION COMBINE-ROOT640)
status_rule: the adapter status is the lowest of its tools' statuses; each tool's own status is in tools[]
